blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Approves Revamped Khelo India Scheme & Enhanced ANSFs Assistance with ₹36,441 Cr Outlay. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: 8-fold budget increase creates athlete development pathway from grassroots to TOPS.
Outlay Allocation: Total ₹36,441 crore (FY27 to FY31) comprising ₹29,054 crore for Khelo India and ₹7,387 crore for ANSFs.
New Athlete Category: Introduced 'Emerging Khelo India Athletes (E-KIAs)' alongside school programs KIFS and KIUV.
Coaching Standardisation: Setting up National Coach Accreditation Board (NCAB) to professionalise coaching.
Khelo India outlay (₹29,054 crore) vs National Sports Federations ANSF outlay (₹7,387 crore).
